{{Quote|I can't thank you enough for the compassion you've shown me. And you've exposed Teraud's evil plans to the Empire. I know the Emperor will take care of that mad scientist and this terrible place now.|Mirla to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Mirla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial worker|worker]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She worked in the Imperial Research Facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] known as the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|Warren]]. When chaos erupted in the Warren, Mirla's [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], another Imperial worker, was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. She asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working as an Imperial operative to discover what happened to her husband.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mirla was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
